description: Samsite demo — populate a fresh session end-to-end: AWS resource graph, GitHub repo data, the FedRAMP 20x KSI catalog, then samsite's signed compliance artifacts (which also synthesize authorization-boundary membership). Order matters: samsite-compliance reads aws_account nodes, so boto3 must run first.

collectors.note: AWS resource graph (Route53/CloudFront/S3/Lambda/IAM/...) + the aws_account node the boundary membership depends on.
GitHub repository / Actions data behind the repo landing page.
Refresh the FedRAMP 20x KSI catalog (HTTPS, no credentials).
Signed /.well-known/ compliance artifacts (OSCAL SSP/POA&M, KSI signal, VDR). MUST run after boto3 — synthesizes SCOPED_TO_BOUNDARY membership from the aws_account nodes.
